parsed.scene_description: A person in a white jacket sits at a desk near a window on the left. Behind them is a large wooden bookshelf unit with multiple shelves containing books and small items. To the right, another section of shelving lines a curved wall under a purple ceiling panel. A potted plant stands between the seated person and the central bookshelf. The room features recessed lighting and appears to be a library or study area.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Individual wearing white jacket and glasses, seated at desk on left side of frame, facing right. Profile visible.

objects.label: desk
objects.observation: Dark surface in foreground left holding laptop and papers. Partially obscured by seated person.

objects.label: laptop
objects.observation: Open silver device on desk left, screen facing user. Partially visible.

objects.label: bookshelf unit
objects.observation: Large wooden shelving structure center-right with multiple compartments filled with books. Illuminated from within.

objects.label: potted plant
objects.observation: Green leafy plant in pot positioned between person and central bookshelf. Leaves extend upward.

objects.label: ceiling panel
objects.observation: Purple rectangular surface high in background center. Reflective or glossy finish visible.
